title: I Stand Amazed
lyrics_original: I stand amazed in the presence
Of Jesus the Nazarene,
And wonder how He could love me,
A sinner, condemned, unclean.
How marvelous! How wonderful!
And my song shall ever be:
How marvelous! How wonderful!
Is my Savior’s love for me!
He took my sins and my sorrows,
He made them His very own;
He bore the burden to Calvary,
And suffered and died alone.
How marvelous! How wonderful!
And my song shall ever be:
How marvelous! How wonderful!
Is my Savior’s love for me!
When with the ransomed in glory
His face I at last shall see,
’Twill be my joy through the ages
To sing of His love for me.
How marvelous! How wonderful!
And my song shall ever be:
How marvelous! How wonderful!
Is my Savior’s love for me!

bible_verses.telugu: అయితే దేవుడు మనయెడల తన ప్రేమను వెల్లడిపరచుచున్నాడు; ఎట్లనగా మనమింకను పాపులమై యుండగానే క్రీస్తు మనకొరకు చనిపోయెను.
bible_verses.english: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

bible_verses.telugu: మనము దేవుని పిల్లలమని పిలువబడునట్లు తండ్రి మనకెట్టి ప్రేమ ననుగ్రహించెనొ చూడుడి; మనము దేవుని పిల్లలమే.ఈ హేతువుచేత లోకము మనలను ఎరుగదు, ఏల యనగా అది ఆయనను ఎరుగలేదు.
bible_verses.english: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are!

bible_verses.telugu: అయినను దేవుడు కరుణాసంపన్నుడై యుండి, మనము మన అపరాధములచేత చచ్చినవారమై యుండినప్పుడు సయితము మనయెడల చూపిన తన మహా  ప్రేమచేత మనలను క్రీసు కృపచేత మీరు రక్షింపబడియున్నారు.
bible_verses.english: But because of his great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy, made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in transgressions—it is by grace you have been saved.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I stand in awe of Your incredible love for me. It humbles my heart to know that You took my sins and sorrows and made them Your own. Thank You for looking past my unworthiness and wrapping me in Your grace. May my life forever sing of Your wonderful, marvelous love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I stand in awe of Your incredible love for me. It humbles my heart to know that You took my sins and sorrows and made them Your own. Thank You for looking past my unworthiness and wrapping me in Your grace. May my life forever sing of Your wonderful, marvelous love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: When we pause to consider the depth of Christ's love, our hearts naturally bow in quiet wonder. Jesus did not look at our brokenness and turn away; instead, He drew near, bearing our heaviest sins and sorrows as His own. Standing in His presence leaves us transformed, trading our shame for His endless grace. Today, let your heart rest in the marvelous truth that you are deeply, unconditionally loved by your Savior.
